$comment: definition_statements seeds, MAS written reply of 7 January 2025 (brief 4d). Drafts only: scripts/standards/seed.ts never approves. Checked against mas.reply.20250107. Elena approves each.

statements.text: In a written reply to Parliament on 7 January 2025, MAS stated that the $100 limit will not apply to a cardholder who unwittingly authenticates a 3DS transaction that turns out to be fraudulent, 'as that would be considered negligent'. The reply does not define gross negligence.
statements.note: Reworded from the brief to keep the reply's own words: 'that turns out to be fraudulent' and 'as that would be considered negligent'. The answer was given by the Deputy Prime Minister as Chairman of MAS and published by MAS.

statements.text: The same reply states that if the merchant had not enabled 3DS and a transaction was put through without 3DS authentication, the cardholder would generally not be liable.
statements.note: The reply gives this as an example of a disputed online transaction the card issuer investigates (3(b)).
